route.title: Integral-angle finite strategies and integer-multiple avoidance
route.mathematicalIdea: Use the complete proof.md. A triangle with angle k*t for positive natural k is winning by induction splitting off t. If180=n*t, cut to two integral angles using an open interval multiple, with the acute n=2 exception. Conversely, when180 is not in t*Z, a parent avoiding t*Z has an avoiding child under every cut; the equilateral triangle avoids t*Z and therefore cannot have an inductive finite winning tree.
orderedMilestones: Prove legal cuts preserve valid angle multisets and enumerate cardinality-three multisets without losing multiplicity.
Induct on positive integral target multiples to construct finite winning trees.
For180=n*t produce a cut giving both children positive integral angles, including the acute n=2 case.
Prove the four-case avoidance invariant for integer multiples and use induction on MulanWins to exclude a win for the equilateral triangle when180 is not an integer multiple.
Convert the positive integer180/t into a natural n>=2 and close both directions of the original equivalence.
assumptionsUsed: Only0<t<180 and the exact published IsTriangle,IsCut,MulanWins,MulanCanGuarantee definitions.
mathematicalRisks: Open-interval cut legality, positivity of all children and natural integer coercions must be proved.
Winning requires BOTH children, not a favorable one.
No added rationality or geometric realization hypotheses; finite inductive strategies, not infinite-play claims.

entries.collectionRationale: The detailed supplied mathematical proof replaces initial route generation only. Lean search,DAG construction and all proof gates stay active.
